people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”
translations.bsb: So the Reubenites and Gadites named the altar Witness, for they said, “It is a witness between us that the LORD is God.”
translations.kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.
translations.asv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: For, said they, it is a witness between us that Jehovah is God.
